cut: Doodle 5, DRAFT v1 (23 Oct) — one question: how do you count a forest that is gone? Everyone counts in their own unit: the regulator in hectares, a newspaper in trees, citizens in names, Doodle in what it will plant. (owner, 23 Oct: 'What about a new Doodle video'; the Guardian's investigation of 22 Oct, shared by the owner, is the peg)
argument: Doodle's Muhos data-centre site was cleared before the required environmental assessment: over 300 hectares by the regulator's count, about 250,000 trees by the Guardian's estimate. Citizens gathered over 50,000 names for data-centre rules in days. Doodle plans tree planting across 130 hectares.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: How do you count / a forest that is [gone]?
text.fi: Miten lasketaan metsä, / joka on jo [kaadettu]?
text.ja: もう ない 森を / どう [数える]？

captions.source: The station's question (plan/films/25-count-the-trees.md). The site is Doodle's planned data centre at Muhos (Pyhänsivu–Leppiniemi), cleared in 2026.

text.en: The regulator counts / hectares: over 300, cleared / before the [assessment].
text.fi: Valvoja laskee hehtaareja: / yli 300, hakattu ennen / [ympäristöarviointia].
text.ja: 監督機関は ヘクタールで： / 300超。 [環境影響評価] より / 先に 伐採。

captions.source: LVV (Finland's licensing and supervisory agency), 6 Oct 2026: preparatory work at Muhos and Kajaani to stop until the environmental impact assessments are done; more than 300 hectares cleared at Muhos (AFP; Al Jazeera 7 Oct; TechSpot). About 330 ha is the figure reported as Tuike Finland's own; 'over 300' is the regulator's. Re-checked 23 Oct (plan/films/25-count-the-trees.md).

text.en: A newspaper counted trees: / an estimated [250,000].
text.ja: 新聞は 木を 数えた： / 推定 [25万本]。

captions.source: The Guardian's investigation, 22 Oct 2026 (environment, ng-interactive): an estimated 250,000 trees felled at Muhos, as reported by follow-ups (Tom's Guide; Yahoo News; Shopifreaks: 'an estimated 250,000 trees'; Timberbiz). The original could not be opened from this session; the figure is attributed as the Guardian's estimate on screen (the tag) and never as a count by the station.

text.en: Citizens count names: / over 50,000 in days, / for data-centre [rules].
text.fi: Kansalaiset laskevat nimiä: / yli 50 000 päivissä / datakeskusten [sääntelylle].
text.ja: 市民は 署名を 数える： / 数日で 5万超、 データセンターの / [規制] を 求めて。

captions.source: Citizens' initiative 'Datakeskukset kuriin' (opened 15 Sep 2026): grid-connection conditions for data centres and a data-centre fee; passed the 50,000 signatures that send an initiative to Parliament within days (Yle 'Datakeskuksille rajoituksia vaativa kansalaisaloite etenee eduskuntaan'; Kaleva; Maaseudun Tulevaisuus). Later counts vary (nearly 80,000 in about two weeks; 93,000 in the Guardian follow-ups), so the film says 'over 50,000'. The initiative is about data centres generally; its organiser said the Muhos felling news raised interest.

text.en: Felled: about 250,000 trees. / Planting planned: [130 hectares].
text.fi: Kaadettu: noin 250 000 puuta. / Istutus suunnitteilla: [130 hehtaaria].
text.ja: 伐採： 約25万本。 / 植樹の 計画： [130ヘクタール]。

captions.source: The station's line, two units on purpose. 130 ha: Doodle's own statement (AFP, about 7 Oct): its landscaping and biodiversity plans include tree planting across 130 hectares at Muhos. The sapling patch is drawn at 40 % of the clearing (130 of about 330 ha).

halt.ja: LVVが 作業中止を 命令 · 2026.10.6

guardian.ja: ガーディアン紙の 推定 · 2026.10.22

post.en: Muhos, Finland: Doodle's data-centre site was cleared before the required environmental assessment. Over 300 hectares; about 250,000 trees, by the Guardian's estimate. Doodle plans tree planting across 130 hectares. How do you count a forest? #Finland #datacenter
post.fi: Muhos: Doodlen datakeskustontti hakattiin ennen lain vaatimaa ympäristövaikutusten arviointia. Valvojan mukaan yli 300 hehtaaria; The Guardianin arvion mukaan noin 250 000 puuta. Doodle suunnittelee puiden istutusta 130 hehtaarille. Miten metsä lasketaan?
post.ja: フィンランド・ムホス：Doodleのデータセンター用地は、法が求める環境影響評価の前に伐採された。監督機関によれば300ヘクタール超、ガーディアン紙の推定では約25万本。Doodleは130ヘクタールへの植樹を計画している。森はどう数える？
